ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food chain. A rabbit is labeled primary consumers. A large cat-like animal on the left is labeled secondary consumers. Plants are labeled producers, mushrooms are labeled decomposers, and the words “solar energy” point to the sun. Arrows connect the parts of the food chain. Reasoning: A carnivore is an animal that eats other animals. In the diagram, the secondary consumer is the large cat-like animal, which is the leopard. Therefore, the carnivore is the leopard.
